articles.title: ‘Trump Strait’: US President renames Hormuz after rejecting 7-day ceasefire offer
articles.description: Donald Trump stirred controversy by renaming the Strait of Hormuz to 'Trump Strait' in response to Iran's rejected offer. Iran’s foreign minister warned that normal maritime traffic could be restored in seven days if the US accedes to certain demands. Trump voiced distrust in that possibility, suggesting a potential military escalation, reflecting the waterway's critical role in Iran's leverage and the broader implications for worldwide energy supply.

articles.title: 70-year-old gang-raped, murdered after objecting to men drinking near her home
articles.description: In Lucknow's Mohanlalganj area, a 70-year-old woman was gang-raped and killed by two men. The assault occurred after she objected to their alcohol consumption near her home. Following the incident, the accused attempted to conceal the crime by moving her body to a nearby location. Police obtained CCTV footage and other evidence to identify and arrest the suspects. An FIR was filed at Mohanlalganj police station regarding this tragic event.

articles.description: Evie Haupt, an Iowa farmer, has notably increased her revenue by leasing land for wind turbines. This extra income has been instrumental in alleviating her farm debts following her husband's passing. Even though the turbines occupy less than an acre, she continues her traditional farming practices on the bulk of her land. The rise of wind power is transforming the financial prospects for rural landowners nationwide.

articles.title: Oil prices slide 2% as US-Iran seek path out of war, Saudi supply fears persist
articles.description: Oil prices dropped by more than 2% amid the initiation of US-Iran truce talks, alongside escalating worries about Saudi oil supply. Brent crude fell to $104.30 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate decreased to $92.41. With negotiators examining the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz for sanction relief on Iran, the situation remains tense.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Why Swades actress Gayatri Oberoi walked away from Bollywood
articles.description: Gayatri Oberoi gained recognition for her role as Gita in the film Swades, alongside Shah Rukh Khan. After achieving success, she decided to step away from the film industry to focus on her marriage and family. Gayatri and Vikas Oberoi, a real estate entrepreneur, married in 2005 and have two sons together. Their residence in Mumbai's Juhu is a sprawling nine-storey bungalow designed for functionality and comfort.

articles.title: Ashley Park recalls cancer battle at 15: ‘I wouldn’t be here today’ without life-saving blood donors
articles.description: Ashley Park, now 35, recalls her isolation during leukaemia treatment and the critical role of blood donors. She emphasizes the importance of acknowledging anonymous donors who contributed to her survival. Park has launched a campaign with Abbott to encourage blood donation among students at Big Ten universities. She believes that creating a competitive spirit could engage younger donors effectively.

articles.title: Prince Harry Takes a Leap for a Promise, Then Calls Meghan Markle
articles.description: Prince Harry made headlines by bravely jumping out of a plane in Canada for a charity event honoring veteran Ed Marshall, who is 102 years old. Though Marshall couldn't join due to his age, his grandson Bailey filled in for him. After the descent, Harry promptly called Meghan to reassure her of his safe landing.
